rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and ZIP to a single account, then accessed only that user’s orders. They correctly identified the order as pending and, per policy, offered a modification instead of an exchange. The agent inspected product variants, recommended the highest-resolution waterproof option available (4K), and explicitly stated the intended change and refund amount before performing any write. After receiving clear confirmation, they executed the modification with correct item IDs and payment method, and confirmed success with the correct refund difference. No unauthorized data sharing or cross-account actions occurred. Minor notes: the statement that no further changes/cancellations would be possible and the 5–7 business day refund window were not tool-verified, but they do not contradict any provided tool data and did not affect the correctness of the action. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
